rebuttal_or_critique: While I have carefully considered the arguments for a shift to a neutral stance, I remain convinced that the current macroeconomic environment demands continued caution. Headline CPI inflation at 5.10% remains uncomfortably above our 4.00% target, and the persistence of food inflation at 8.30% poses a tangible risk to the anchoring of inflation expectations. With the economy exhibiting resilient GVA growth of 6.80% and a positive output gap of 0.50%, the case for a premature change in stance is not supported by the data. I believe it is imperative to maintain the withdrawal of accommodation to ensure that the disinflationary process is durable and that we do not signal a premature easing of our commitment to price stability. I will hold my ground on the current stance to ensure policy consistency.
